items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I think Nick, said the same thing

ctx.x: Yes. I'm sorry today that I switched, really.

Well, Barney stayed with the Albert, but somebody I was interviewing, I think Nick, said the same thing, he was sorry he switched. But he said he said he couldn't go back because he'd never make the notes.

There's the thought of going back. Every time I pick up an Albert System clarinet... In fact, if I could have gotten my old Albert System back from the museum... I only loaned it to them, I...
